products.name: Algae-watch CubeSat
products.oneLine: A small satellite designed to give UAE desalination plants early warning of harmful algal blooms.
products.madeBy: Parth leads the team and designed the avionics: a two-processor flight computer, the power system and attitude control.

facts.label: Processors that cover for each other if one fails
Avionics boards (data handling, power, attitude control)

products.statusNote: In design: a 1U technology demonstrator first, then a 2–4U operational satellite.
products.bestBefore: Turning the satellite into a business, as the RUYA judges suggested.

products.name: Artificial Lagrange Points
products.oneLine: A Python desktop app that finds where a spacecraft can hold position in the Earth–Moon system with the least continuous thrust.

headline.text: Public code on GitHub, technical paper submitted

products.madeBy: Parth wrote the app and worked out the maths behind it.
products.statusNote: The app and its code are public.
products.bestBefore: A public launch through the @space.valet Instagram account.

products.madeBy: Parth built both tests for My Career Horizons.
